can_edit.description:
Omitted means true: an invitation has always meant "may edit", and a
client that predates viewers keeps getting what it asked for.

collaborators.description: Invited at creation, in the same transaction as the playlist itself.

refresh_token.description:
Optional: the caller may not have kept it. Without it only the access
token is dropped, and the session dies at the next refresh attempt.
